crossRefs.note: Raise a song, and bring here the tambourine, the pleasant lyre with the harp.
Blow the trumpet at the New Moon, at the full moon, on our feast day.
Sing praises to Yahweh with the harp, with the harp and the voice of melody.
With trumpets and sound of the ram’s horn, make a joyful noise before the King, Yahweh.
“Also in the day of your gladness, and in your set feasts, and in the beginnings of your months, you shall blow the…
Shebaniah, Joshaphat, Nethanel, Amasai, Zechariah, Benaiah, and Eliezer, the priests, blew the trumpets before God’s…
Thus all Israel brought the ark of Yahweh’s covenant up with shouting, with sound of the cornet, with trumpets, and…
and with them Heman and Jeduthun with trumpets and cymbals for those that should sound aloud, and with instruments for…
that whenever you hear the sound of the horn, flute, zither, lyre, harp, pipe, and all kinds of music, you fall down…
Give thanks to Yahweh with the lyre. Sing praises to him with the harp of ten strings.
with the ten-stringed lute, with the harp, and with the melody of the lyre.
Wake up, harp and lyre! I will wake up the dawn.
Let them praise his name in the dance! Let them sing praises to him with tambourine and harp!

translations.web: Praise him with the sounding of the trumpet! Praise him with harp and lyre!
translations.bsb: Praise Him with the sound of the horn; praise Him with the harp and lyre.
translations.kjv: Praise him with the sound of the trumpet: praise him with the psaltery and harp.
translations.asv: Praise him with trumpet sound: Praise him with psaltery and harp.
